# case: 62-layer-no-terminal-fails-closed
# desc: with an unbuilt tooling layer and no terminal to confirm on, the launcher fails closed and names both --build-layer and --no-layer
# config: apple-darwin
--- exit ---
1
--- runtime-args ---
(empty)
--- stdout ---
(empty)
--- stderr ---
error: a tooling layer must be built and there is no terminal to confirm on.
       Pass --build-layer to build it, or --no-layer to run the base image.
--- filesystem ---
HOME dir 755
PROJ dir 755
PROJ/.claude-contained dir 755
PROJ/.claude-contained/layer dir 755
PROJ/.claude-contained/layer/Dockerfile file 644
  | ARG BASE_IMAGE=claude-contained:latest
  | FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}
  | RUN echo layer-marker > /usr/local/share/layer-marker
